name: Bridge
summary: A small developer humanoid launched alongside OpenBridge, an open ecosystem of shared development tools, training resources and a public Skill Hub where contributors publish behaviors others can build on. The hardware is deliberately modest — 88 cm, two-finger grippers — with the open motion-control APIs, SDK and motion-capture/VR integration as the product.
notable: Launched with the OpenBridge open-source ecosystem and Skill Hub
